info.name: lightning-forge-enhancement-migration-api Postman Collection
info.description:
A high-performance orchestration service designed to automate code enhancements, 
dependency migrations, and structural fixes for legacy Java applications. 
Leverages Git, Maven, and GCS for seamless modernization.


OpenAPI version: 1.0.0

request.description:
Start a new code enhancement pipeline

Responses:
- 202: Enhancement job accepted and queued for execution.
- 400: The request payload is malformed or fails validation.
